title: Access Classification
description: Seven access classes with inheritance. Access-class filters apply before retrieval AND before model context (SECURITY_MODEL.controls). Deny by default.

inherited_from.description: object_id whose classification this object inherits; the most restrictive of self vs. inherited wins.

x-inheritance-rule: An object's effective classification is the MOST RESTRICTIVE of its own level and every ancestor it inherits from. Ordering (least→most restrictive): PUBLIC < INTERNAL < RESTRICTED < SENSITIVE_LOCATION < LEGAL_HOLD < QUARANTINED. TEST_ONLY is orthogonal and must never surface in operational (non-test) snapshots.
x-invariants: Policy parity: the same access decision governs search, map, export, document viewer, and model context (citation_access_policy_violations_max == 0).
QUARANTINED and TEST_ONLY objects are never returned to operational queries or placed in model context.
